celebrates: Stillwater turns its historic riverfront downtown into a Christmas village through its Hometown for the Holidays season. The city lights its tree at Chestnut Plaza on Saturday, December 5, with a Twinkle Party from 4:30 to 6:30 pm that features Victorian carolers, appearances by Elsa and Olaf and free twinkle lights for children. Discover Stillwater runs The Great Gingerbread Man Hunt from November 30 to December 20, sending families into downtown shops with a stamp card to find hidden gingerbread ornaments, and a Gingerbread Man puppet show moved here from the Minneapolis page.
lastyear: Hometown for the Holidays is the umbrella Discover Stillwater uses for its downtown season, and the city's calendar lists the Twinkle Party and Tree Lighting as part of it again in 2026. We did not find a published recap of the 2025 evening from the city or Discover Stillwater, so this page does not describe last year's turnout. The Gingerbread Man Hunt listing on Discover Stillwater's events calendar runs for three weeks this year, giving families many chances to visit shops.
facts: The Great Gingerbread Man Hunt works like a scavenger hunt: families pick up a stamp card at any participating business and look for hidden gingerbread ornaments in downtown shops, then complete it between Monday, November 30 and Sunday, December 20, 2026. The Twinkle Party at Chestnut Plaza also lists Victorian carolers and appearances by Elsa and Olaf, and the city says children can pick up free twinkle lights.
trains: Stillwater has no holiday train ride that we could verify for 2026. Across the St. Croix River, the Minnesota Transportation Museum lists Santa's Train Shop tickets for Osceola, Wisconsin, at trainride.org, so check that site for current dates. The CPKC Holiday Train stops at Depot Park in Hastings on December 12 from 8:45 to 9:15 pm, according to the City of Hastings. In Minneapolis, the Minnesota Streetcar Museum runs historic streetcars on the Como-Harriet line.
